# Anne Shirley & Paul Irving

- [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) — Friend of — [Paul Irving](../character/paul-irving.md) — fast friends · since v2  <sub>[v2 V A Full-fledged Schoolma’am P8](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0008), [v2 XV The Beginning of Vacation P45](../source/v02-c15.md#nw-v02-c15-p0045), [v2 XXVII An Afternoon at the Stone House P22](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0022)</sub>
- [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) — Mentor of — [Paul Irving](../character/paul-irving.md) — pupil at her school · since v2  <sub>[v2 I An Irate Neighbor P45](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0045), [v2 XXVI Around the Bend P24](../source/v02-c26.md#nw-v02-c26-p0024)</sub>

## Shared scenes

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) returns to [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) to find [Dora](../character/dora.md) missing and everyone frantically searching for her. After searching the well and surrounding area with Mr. [Barry](../character/barry.md), [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) finds [Dora](../character/dora.md) locked in Mr. Harrison's toolhouse by [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md). [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md) is confronted and tearfully promises never to lie again after realizing he made [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) cry, though he later questions [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) about Marilla's warning regarding prayers.
>
> — v2 · X Davy in Search of a Sensation

_Sources: [v2 X Davy in Search of a Sensation P8](../source/v02-c10.md#nw-v02-c10-p0008), [v2 X Davy in Search of a Sensation P26](../source/v02-c10.md#nw-v02-c10-p0026), [v2 X Davy in Search of a Sensation P34](../source/v02-c10.md#nw-v02-c10-p0034), [v2 X Davy in Search of a Sensation P52](../source/v02-c10.md#nw-v02-c10-p0052)_

> In a bad mood from a toothache, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) accidentally causes fireworks to explode in the schoolroom and subsequently whips [Anthony Pye](../character/anthony-pye.md) after he puts a mouse in her desk. She goes home heartbroken over her bad day, but [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) comforts her. The next morning, Anthony treats [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) with new respect, and Mrs. Rachel [Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md) later confirms that the whipping gained his approval.
>
> — v2 · XII A Jonah Day

_Sources: [v2 XII A Jonah Day P19](../source/v02-c12.md#nw-v02-c12-p0019), [v2 XII A Jonah Day P33](../source/v02-c12.md#nw-v02-c12-p0033), [v2 XII A Jonah Day P36](../source/v02-c12.md#nw-v02-c12-p0036), [v2 XII A Jonah Day P49](../source/v02-c12.md#nw-v02-c12-p0049)_

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) finishes the school year and walks toward the cemetery, joining [Paul Irving](../character/paul-irving.md) along the way as he shares thoughts about his parents and rock people. At the graveyard, after tending to the graves of [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md) and [Hester Gray](../character/hester-gray.md), [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) meets Mrs. [Allan](../character/allan.md), and they discuss teaching, ideals, and friendship on their walk home.
>
> — v2 · XV The Beginning of Vacation

_Sources: [v2 XV The Beginning of Vacation P0](../source/v02-c15.md#nw-v02-c15-p0000), [v2 XV The Beginning of Vacation P2](../source/v02-c15.md#nw-v02-c15-p0002), [v2 XV The Beginning of Vacation P24](../source/v02-c15.md#nw-v02-c15-p0024), [v2 XV The Beginning of Vacation P26](../source/v02-c15.md#nw-v02-c15-p0026)_

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) spends time with [Paul Irving](../character/paul-irving.md), sharing tea and discussing his imaginative thoughts and childhood worries. Later at home, she tucks in [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md), who deals with his feelings of jealousy toward [Paul](../character/paul-irving.md). Afterwards, she runs into [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) by the Dryad's [Bubble](../codex/places.md#dryad-s-bubble).
>

_Sources: [v2 XIX Just a Happy Day P2](../source/v02-c19.md#nw-v02-c19-p0002), [v2 XIX Just a Happy Day P23](../source/v02-c19.md#nw-v02-c19-p0023), [v2 XIX Just a Happy Day P34](../source/v02-c19.md#nw-v02-c19-p0034), [v2 XIX Just a Happy Day P50](../source/v02-c19.md#nw-v02-c19-p0050)_
